arguments.value: Andrew J. Guilford is a former United States District Judge for the Central District of California, where he served from 2006 until his retirement in 2020, assuming senior status in 2019. Born in Santa Monica, California, he earned his A.B. from the University of California, Los Angeles, in 1972 and his J.D. from UCLA School of Law in 1975. Before joining the federal bench, he practiced law in private practice in Costa Mesa, California, for more than three decades from 1975 to 2006.
